name: telego-nullpair-v3
instr:
**Blank cells in our rich-message rota show up as empty boxes**

Our on-call bot posts the weekly rota with `SendRichMessage`: one bordered table, weekdays across
the top, teams down the side. The top-left corner and a spacer row between team groups are plain
`telego.RichBlockTableCell{}` with no Text, since the Bot API says a cell without text is
invisible. A day nobody covers gets a cell whose text is an empty string. Since we upgraded
telego, the Telegram apps draw the corner and the spacer row as empty bordered boxes.

Our egress proxy shows the corner and spacer cells leaving in the sendRichMessage body as
`"text": ""`. In the Message that `SendRichMessage` returns, those cells have no Text.

The checkout is in /workdir. Could you track down where this actually goes wrong and fix it
there? Please include a regression test, as a _test.go file (say ./repro_test.go, next to the code
it tests), that fails on the current code because of this problem (a real test failure, not an
import error) and passes once it's fixed.
Test the reported behaviour, not your patch: it should still pass if the bug gets fixed some other correct
way, so no asserting on source text or on helpers only your fix has. It should run on its own
from a clean checkout with just your test files added.

I doubt I'm the only one hitting this. Anything else that goes through that code is probably
wrong too, so please fix it at the source rather than special-casing my input. The fix belongs in
the library itsel
